page.layout: Four blocks on one page. Upper left: a large woodcut of a tree with medallion roundels, framed. Upper right: a calendar column of saints' names and feast days with red and black letters, and a column of numerals running down beside it. Lower left: a column of saints' names and marks under the red heading "Christmonat/", with a narrow column of black-letter ornaments on its right. Lower middle: a column of small numerals 1 to 15 with a line of text beside it. Lower right: a woodcut of a figure and a building, with small numerals and a few lines of text. No margin notes.
page.notes: Woodcuts (tree of medallions; figure and building) are not transcribed. The page is a calendar with many numerals in columns; the lower-middle numbers 1–15 and the numbers at right are printed as column figures and are not transcribed individually. Much of the right-hand text and the bottom-right lines are faint or damaged by stains, so several readings are doubtful. Black-letter ornaments in the lower-left column are not text.
